module: Flowgraph node "Career Active" (category repeat_instant). Tests whether career mode is active via career_career.isActive(). Outputs: enabled (flow if active), disabled (flow otherwise), active (hidden bool). Also sets flow to true.
notes: Declares a dependency on gameplay_walk although it uses career_career (probable copy-paste).
The output pin "flow" is not declared in pinSchema but work writes to it.

work.desc: Fills enabled, disabled and active according to career_career.isActive().

drawMiddle.desc: Displays a check or cross icon.
